decisions.statement: Every picture is worked out once as the service starts.
A picture is worked out again only when a file the picture is made from changes.
A picture is in memory between one change and the next.
A file is written under the cooldown its own page states.
A file below a folder a picture reads is no file that picture is made from.
The folders every picture reads are watched once rather than once per picture.
A picture states the folders that picture reads and the files there the picture is made from.
The pages a picture is made from are the pages the index names of a page type.
A folder holding such a page is read because the index names that page.
No folder here is walked to find which pages exist.
A picture states the page types that picture draws.
A picture is taken again where the index files the slugs of one of those types.
A page coming into being, going, or being renamed is what writes there.
Where a page type's slugs are filed is asked of the index rather than spelled.
Those folders are followed one picture at a time rather than across pictures.
No folder the repository leaves untracked is followed for such an event.
A seat that appears while the service runs is read from then on.
The folders a picture reads are worked out as the service starts.
A picture that could not be taken answers no line rather than an empty line.
No file is written for a picture answering no line.
The line left on disk from before the service started is the line kept.
A throw ends the service rather than being caught and logged.
No picture here is taken on a beat.
No picture here is made from committed pages alone.
A picture landing on disk is where the service leaves for code that moved.

definition: the loop holding what the editor draws and writing it where the editor reads
